panels.description: Скорость считается как разница последней валидной температуры и температуры на выбранный интервал назад, пересчитанная в °C/мин.

targets.rawSql:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT make_interval(secs => ${Rate_Interval:raw}::int) AS dt
), active_sensors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (sm.global_channel)
    sm.global_channel,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(sm.sensor_name, ''), concat('Датчик ', sm.global_channel)) AS sensor_name
  FROM public.sensor_measurements sm
  WHERE sm.sensor_used = true
    AND sm.sensor_kind_code = 1
    AND sm.global_channel BETWEEN 1 AND 32
  ORDER BY sm.global_channel, sm."time" DESC
), points AS (
  SELECT
    a.global_channel,
    a.sensor_name,
    last_point."time" AS last_time,
    last_point.temperature AS last_temperature,
    previous_point."time" AS previous_time,
    previous_point.temperature AS previous_temperature
  FROM active_sensors a
  CROSS JOIN params p
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT sm."time", sm.temperature
    FROM public.sensor_measurements sm
    WHERE sm.global_channel = a.global_channel
      AND sm.sensor_used = true
      AND sm.valid = true
      AND sm.temperature IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY sm."time" DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) last_point ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT sm."time", sm.temperature
    FROM public.sensor_measurements sm
    WHERE sm.global_channel = a.global_channel
      AND sm.sensor_used = true
      AND sm.valid = true
      AND sm.temperature IS NOT NULL
      AND sm."time" <= now() - p.dt
    ORDER BY sm."time" DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) previous_point ON true
)
SELECT
  concat(global_channel, ' - ', sensor_name) AS "metric",
  ROUND(
    (
      (last_temperature - previous_temperature)
      / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (last_time - previous_time)), 0)
      * 60.0
    )::numeric,
    3
  ) AS "value"
FROM points
WHERE last_temperature IS NOT NULL
  AND previous_temperature IS NOT NULL
  AND last_time > previous_time
ORDER BY global_channel;

panels.title: Скорости изменения температуры ТД

targets.rawSql:
WITH save_graph AS (
    INSERT INTO public.grafana_variable_state (dashboard_uid, graph_1, updated_at)
    VALUES ('td-speeds', ${Graph_1}::integer, now())
    ON CONFLICT (dashboard_uid) DO UPDATE
    SET graph_1 = EXCLUDED.graph_1, updated_at = now()
    RETURNING graph_1
), src AS (
    SELECT
        "time",
        temperature,
        lag("time") OVER (ORDER BY "time") AS previous_time,
        lag(temperature) OVER (ORDER BY "time") AS previous_temperature
    FROM public.sensor_measurements
    WHERE
        global_channel = ${Graph_1}
        AND sensor_used = true
        AND valid = true
        AND sensor_kind_code = 1
        AND temperature IS NOT NULL
        AND "time" >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - make_interval(secs => ${Rate_Interval:raw}::int)
        AND "time" <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
), speed AS (
    SELECT
        "time",
        ROUND(
            (
                (temperature - previous_temperature)
                / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("time" - previous_time)), 0)
                * 60.0
            )::numeric,
            3
        ) AS value
    FROM src
    WHERE previous_temperature IS NOT NULL
      AND previous_time IS NOT NULL
      AND "time" > previous_time
      AND $__timeFilter("time")
)
SELECT
    "time",
    value,
    'Скорость, °C/мин' AS metric
FROM speed
ORDER BY "time";

WITH save_graph AS (
    INSERT INTO public.grafana_variable_state (dashboard_uid, graph_2, updated_at)
    VALUES ('td-speeds', ${Graph_2}::integer, now())
    ON CONFLICT (dashboard_uid) DO UPDATE
    SET graph_2 = EXCLUDED.graph_2, updated_at = now()
    RETURNING graph_2
), src AS (
    SELECT
        "time",
        temperature,
        lag("time") OVER (ORDER BY "time") AS previous_time,
        lag(temperature) OVER (ORDER BY "time") AS previous_temperature
    FROM public.sensor_measurements
    WHERE
        global_channel = ${Graph_2}
        AND sensor_used = true
        AND valid = true
        AND sensor_kind_code = 1
        AND temperature IS NOT NULL
        AND "time" >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - make_interval(secs => ${Rate_Interval:raw}::int)
        AND "time" <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
), speed AS (
    SELECT
        "time",
        ROUND(
            (
                (temperature - previous_temperature)
                / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("time" - previous_time)), 0)
                * 60.0
            )::numeric,
            3
        ) AS value
    FROM src
    WHERE previous_temperature IS NOT NULL
      AND previous_time IS NOT NULL
      AND "time" > previous_time
      AND $__timeFilter("time")
)
SELECT
    "time",
    value,
    'Скорость, °C/мин' AS metric
FROM speed
ORDER BY "time";

list.definition:
WITH choices AS (
  SELECT
    concat(gs.global_channel, ' - ', latest.sensor_name) AS __text,
    gs.global_channel AS __value
  FROM generate_series(1, 32) AS gs(global_channel)
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(sm.sensor_name, ''), concat('Датчик ', gs.global_channel)) AS sensor_name
    FROM public.sensor_measurements sm
    WHERE sm.sensor_used = true
      AND sm.sensor_kind_code = 1
      AND sm.global_channel = gs.global_channel
    ORDER BY sm."time" DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) latest
), last_selected AS (
  SELECT graph_1 AS value
  FROM public.grafana_variable_state
  WHERE dashboard_uid = 'td-speeds'
)
SELECT __text, __value
FROM choices
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN __value = COALESCE((SELECT value FROM last_selected), 1) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  __value;
